title: The 6.2.x ph init scaffold declares no runtime dependencies and lints with oxlint/oxfmt instead of eslint/prettier
content:
## Verified against the template, not the docs

**The academy has not been updated for this** — its project-structure pages still describe the older scaffold (eslint/prettier scripts, a `dependencies` block). The template source is authoritative.

`packageJsonTemplate` emits **no `dependencies` key at all**. It writes exactly `peerDependencies` and `devDependencies`, both alphabetically sorted. That is what makes a Powerhouse package installable into a host that already supplies the runtime: the host (Connect, Switchboard, or a reactor) owns `document-model`, `@powerhousedao/reactor-browser` and friends, and the package must not drag a second copy in. It also explains `"files": ["/dist"]` and `"sideEffects": false` — the compiled output ships, the source trees do not.

Linting and formatting are **oxlint and oxfmt**:

```json
"lint":         "oxlint --type-aware --type-check",
"lint:fix":     "oxlint --type-aware --type-check --fix",
"format":       "oxfmt",
"format:check": "oxfmt --check"
```

`--type-aware --type-check` means the lint step performs TypeScript type checking too, which is why lint failures in a fresh project can look like `tsc` errors. `tsc`, `tsc:watch`, `vitest` (`test`, `test:watch`, `test:coverage`) and `check-circular-imports` (dpdm over `./index.ts`) round out the scripts, alongside thin `ph-cli` passthroughs: `generate`, `connect`, `build`, `reactor`, `service`, `vetra`.

The project-files builder writes `.oxlintrc.json` and `.oxfmtrc.json` at the project root — there is no `.eslintrc` or `.prettierrc` to find. It also emits **`reactor/index.ts`**, a headless entry point, so the package can be booted without a browser host.

One inconsistency worth flagging: the scaffold's `"service": "ph-cli service"` script points at a command that is *not* registered in `phCliCommands` or `phCliCommandNames`, so it is not dispatchable — the same gap that makes the Launch docs' `ph service setup` / `ph service restart` instructions stale.

_Source: `packages/codegen/src/templates/boilerplate/package.json.ts` and `packages/codegen/src/file-builders/boilerplate/generated-project-files.ts`, Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.45._
description: package.json emits only peerDependencies and devDependencies; the scaffold writes .oxlintrc.json and .oxfmtrc.json plus a headless reactor/index.ts entry.
